name: rc-contract
sql: UPDATE remediation_contracts SET verify_probe = (SELECT 'SELECT ''0'' AS expected, CAST((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.reopens_24h + r.opens_24h), 0) FROM issue_recurrence_now r WHERE r.family = ''' || replace(substr(a.title, 15, instr(a.title, ' keeps recurring') - 15), '''', '''''') || ''') + (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM issue_recurrence_now) + COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN x.created_at < (CAST(strftime(''%s'', ''now'') AS INTEGER) - 86400) * 1000 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM agent_issues x WHERE x.id = ' || a.id || '), 0) AS TEXT) AS observed' FROM agent_issues a WHERE a.id = CAST(substr(remediation_contracts.class, 7) AS INTEGER)), verify_transport = 'd1-query', issue_id = CAST(substr(remediation_contracts.class, 7) AS INTEGER), status = 'active', last_verdict = NULL, attempts = 0, deferred_since = NULL, next_due_at = datetime('now'), expected_cadence_h = 1, module = 'probe-template-v4-root-cause', precondition = 'ROOT-CAUSE-CONTRACT-1 (agent_issues 1000419): the ticket closes when its family has no reopen and no new issue for 24 hours', action = 'MEASURES the closing condition: expected 0, observed the family reopens_24h plus opens_24h in issue_recurrence_now, plus 1 while the ticket is under 24 hours old, plus 1 while the snapshot is empty. It reads the snapshot and not v_root_cause_quiet, so a failing read never hides the ticket from the view that closes it. ROOT-CAUSE-CONTRACT-1.' WHERE status = 'superseded' AND substr(action, 1, 18) = 'VACUOUS-PROBE-V3-1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues t WHERE t.id = CAST(substr(remediation_contracts.class, 7) AS INTEGER) AND 'issue-' || t.id = remediation_contracts.class AND t.status = 'open' AND t.title LIKE 'ROOT-CAUSE-1: % keeps recurring' AND instr(t.title, ';') = 0)
